readinessMatrix.evidence: Repository lacks statewide MoPR LGD subdistrict directory artifact for Telangana; only 12-mandal pilot slice exists.
Ministry of Panchayati Raj (MoPR LGD) and Government of Telangana Revenue Dept established as legal authorities.
Exhaustively reconciled in docs/w016_c2_candidate_geometry_reconciliation.md; all 23 missing mandals identified.
Zero synthetic records created; 23 mandals documented as post-2016 bifurcations.
577 out of 589 mandals in docs/w016_c2_mandal_identifier_mapping.csv record NOT_PRESENT_IN_SOURCE for LGD code.
public.mandal_versions table schema on staging verified with 16 columns and Option A temporal triggers.
Migration 044 partial GiST index (uq_mandal_versions_historical_no_overlap) accommodates closed-open historical intervals.
No historical W012 dataset version exists in dataset_versions for the 2016 mandal baseline (e.g. ts_lgd_mandals_2016_v1).
No statewide MoPR LGD subdistrict export or G.O.Ms. 220–250 statutory schedule is archived in data/evidence/.
dataset_versions, evidence_records, and provenance_records infrastructure is live and verified on staging.
TGRAC candidate layer lacks lgd_code, name_te, and census_code_2011; cannot populate public.mandals or mandal_versions without LGD.
Temporal model correctly attributes 2016 area to parent mandals; child bifurcations start on their post-2016 gazette dates.
Prerequisites BLK-W016-DATA-01 and BLK-W016-DATA-02 must be resolved before any DML data load can be authorized.

blockers.title: Absence of Authoritative Statewide MoPR LGD Subdistrict Directory Artifact
blockers.description: The repository currently contains only a 12-mandal pilot slice in data/evidence/w015_b2/mopr_lgd_subdistrict_directory_ts.json. The TGRAC candidate geospatial layer contains 589 features and English names, but completely lacks statutory integer LGD subdistrict codes. Without acquiring the complete statewide LGD directory from lgdirectory.gov.in, canonical mandal IDs (TS-MDL-<lgd_code>) cannot be generated without data fabrication or unverified inference.

blockers.title: Missing Historical 2016 Mandal W012 Dataset Version
blockers.description: There is currently no W012 dataset version in public.dataset_versions governing the 2016 post-reorganisation mandals (e.g. ts_lgd_mandals_2016_v1). The existing fixture ts_lgd_mandals_staging_official_v1 has effective_from = '2023-01-01' and points to the 12-mandal pilot JSON. A dedicated W012 dataset version backed by an authoritative LGD/Gazette evidence artifact must be registered.

remediationPlanForCTO.step1: Acquire official MoPR LGD subdistrict directory export for all 612 mandals of Telangana from lgdirectory.gov.in.
remediationPlanForCTO.step2: Archive the export as data/evidence/w016/mopr_lgd_subdistrict_directory_telangana_all.json with SHA-256 digest.
remediationPlanForCTO.step3: Construct deterministic join between TGRAC 589 features and MoPR LGD records on (district, normalized_mandal_name).
remediationPlanForCTO.step4: Register W012 evidence_record and dataset_version ts_lgd_mandals_2016_v1.
remediationPlanForCTO.step5: Generate deterministic, non-fabricated SQL migration/seed script to insert 589 mandals into public.mandals and historical versions into public.mandal_versions.
